item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=reliability+of+independent+judgment+in+the+face+of+expert+consensus&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1007/978-0-585-34290-0_4\", \"title\": [\"Reliability and Validity in Expert Judgment\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1007/978-0-585-34290-0_4\"}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1109/rams.2007.328099\", \"title\": [\"Modeling Expert Judgment for Reliability Prediction - Comparison of Methods\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1109/rams.2007.328099\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2007]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1093/ijpor/edac033\", \"title\": [\"Correction to: Do Populists Really Reject Expert Judgment?: Expert Consensus and Support for Clean Water Act Protections\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1093/ijpor/edac033\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2022, 9, 1]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1108/oxan-db243075\", \"title\": [\"Nigeria’s independent institutions face major threats\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:sec sec-type=\\\"significance\\\">\\n               <jats:title content-type=\\\"abstract-subheading\\\">Significance</jats:title>\\n               <jats:p>Onnoghen was suspended by President Muhammadu Buhari in January after the chief justice's indictment over the alleged non-declaration of assets in an apparently politically-motivated case. Meanwhile, Buhari’s principal challenger in last February’s presidential election, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar of the opposition People’s Democratic Party (PDP), is still challenging the poll result. </jats:p>\\n            </jats:sec>\\n            <jats:sec sec-type=\\\"impacts\\\">\\n               <jats:title content-type=\\\"abstract-subheading\\\">Impacts</jats:title>\\n               <jats:p>Public interest in governance reforms could wane, with a shift to ensuring stability over advocating change. </jats:p>\\n               <jats:p>The military and security services will face growing scrutiny and criticism over their increased politicisation. </jats:p>\\n               <jats:p>Intensified leadership divisions within the ruling APC could increasingly frustrate Buhari’s agenda during his second term. </jats:p>\\n               <jats:p>A mooted probe of the army’s role in the recent elections is unlikely to result in any major sanctions.</jats:p>\…
